messages:
ali: Quick sync — can we confirm owners & blockers for the next compliance sprint? Primary goals: SOC2 fieldwork readiness, KMS/HSM attestation, and audit-log ingestion verification. I want a short owners list + any blockers by EOD.

morgan: Owner list from my side: audit-log pipeline -> @sam, evidence bucket + retention policy -> @vivian. No blockers on pipeline except a small schema diff with staging logs.

sam: Confirmed. I'll review the schema diff today. PR #3421 is open, pinged @erica for review. If we merge by tomorrow we can run end-to-end test Thu.

vivian: Evidence bucket owner here. Need clarification on retention setting for backup snapshots — SOC2 wants 90 days but legal asked for 365 for some customers. Can we make retention per-customer?

erica: For PR review on #3421 — small nits only. Also we need to update the ingest docs: add the `x-audit-source` header requirement. I'll approve after that.

ali: Good. @devops-oncall can you confirm the canary flow for ingest once PR is merged? We don't want to ship to prod before a controlled rollout.

devops-oncall: Canary plan: merge -> deploy to staging -> 12h smoke -> deploy to canary (10% traffic) for 6 hours -> metrics check (error rate, latency, token cost). I'll attach a quick runbook: `deploy canary --audittest`.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 fieldwork window opens 2025-06-02. Evidence snapshots due 2025-05-28.

jordan: KMS/HSM side: hardware attestation vendor handed over test certs. Waiting on network ACL change from infra (ticket INF-778). Without the ACL change we can't complete on-prem attestation tests.

ali: Who owns INF-778? @morgan?

morgan: That one is with infra/eng-infra; I can chase but we need an ETA. Putting @devops-oncall as backup to escalate.

sam: Risk flag: if INF-778 slips past 2025-05-20 we won't have HSM attestation in time for the fieldwork window. Can we get a contingency — a cloud KMS attestation doc snapshot to present to auditors?

vivian: We can prepare a controls mapping doc for cloud KMS as fallback. I'll draft and drop in #docs by Friday.

erica: Quick check: who will own audit interview prep? I can collate questions but need subject-matter experts for answers (key rotation, access matrix).

ali: Assigning: audit interview prep -> @erica (lead), SME: @morgan (KMS policy), @vivian (evidence retention), @sam (ingest). Please add any supporting docs to the evidence bucket with path `evidence/fieldwork/{component}`.

devops-oncall: I've scheduled the ACL change reminder and will escalate if no action by tomorrow noon PT.

morgan: I'll ping infra slack and set a short meeting if needed.

ali: Action items recap (quick):
- sam: merge PR #3421 + run e2e tests (due: 2025-05-15)
- erica: collate interview Qs + update docs (due: 2025-05-16)
- vivian: draft controls mapping for cloud KMS fallback (due: 2025-05-16)
- devops-oncall: run canary deploy runbook + escalate INF-778 if not done (due: 2025-05-14)
- morgan: chase INF-778 + SME for KMS policy (ongoing)

ali: If anyone can't meet these dates reply here with the blocker. Otherwise I'll follow up in the sprint board and mark owners. :white_check_mark:
